result.reason: The clause adds the preferred USD 5 million cyber limit and retains workers’ compensation, certificates on request, and the fallback USD 1 million E&O limit. However, it does not require the CGL coverage to be USD 1 million per occurrence and USD 2 million aggregate, so it does not reach the playbook position. It also uses “Company data or accesses Company systems” rather than clearly covering privacy liability for vendors processing Customer Data. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language deficiencies.
